verdict.rationale: Orama's pricing page says the open-source library adds search "at no cost," so self-hosted library costs are predictable. Nothing in the evidence shows published per-unit pricing (per search, record, or node) for the managed Orama Cloud service. A founder therefore cannot forecast hosted search costs from this evidence. Missing for 10: published per-unit Cloud pricing (searches/records/nodes), plan limits or tier details, and independent corroboration of cost predictability.
